title: Wildheart seeded as an in-house program Space

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-12: set up Wildheart as if it had gone through the seeding process, like Hearts on Fire; stock theme, website published by hand

detail: The Wildheart Space (spaces.id 5c7c46d1-a2ba-4e58-a942-c1fe6a68e74b) was created on 2026-10-12 with the typo slug `wilheart`, plan free, no about, no preferences, one empty primary circle and no events, journeys or program. scripts/seed-wildheart.sql (one idempotent transaction, generated by `pnpm seed:wildheart --sql` from scripts/seed-wildheart.mts, the REST twin) seeds it the way Hearts on Fire is seeded: the Space row (slug wildheart, collective, limits_waived, dawn, network, America/Los_Angeles, HoF's entitlement keys, preferences pages/pageDocs/siteHero/profileData/profileLayout/programOverview/profilePublished; theme and websitePublished deliberately absent), the circle renamed Wildheart Circle One at capacity 12, the Circle Night anchor (FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TU from Tue 2026-11-03 18:00 PT) plus its first 60 days of occurrences as the cron mints them, the eight Foundation Tuesdays, the festivals, moons and Hearth Gatherings from the owner-approved 2027 ritual calendar, the Samhain retreat as one multi-day event, two Journeys (Wildheart Foundation: 8 phases, 8 modules, 8 lessons; The Wildheart Year: ongoing, drip 30, 12 phases, 12 modules) and the Program (circle_templates blueprint + topical_channels + circle_channels). Logo and cover are NOT written: the SQL names the library-media bucket path and the UPDATE to run after the upload. The owner applies the SQL by hand; this row closes once the VERIFY selects in the file return the expected counts.

verify.evidence: After applying scripts/seed-wildheart.sql to production, the VERIFY selects in the file must return: spaces (id 5c7c46d1-a2ba-4e58-a942-c1fe6a68e74b): slug wildheart, plan collective, limits_waived t, skin dawn, visibility network, time_zone America/Los_Angeles, preferences has no theme and no websitePublished, profilePublished true, 6 pages, 6 pageDocs. circles where space_id = Wildheart: 1 row, Wildheart Circle One, member_cap 12, primary_pillar body. events where space_id = Wildheart: 57 total, 1 recurring anchor (wildheart-circle-night-2026-11-03, FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TU, Tue 2026-11-03 18:00 PT), 4 occurrences with parent_event_id, 8 with journey_id, 30 moon circles, 1 multi-day retreat. journey_plans where space_id = Wildheart: wildheart-foundation (8 phases, 8 modules, 8 lessons, ongoing f) and the-wildheart-year (12 phases, 12 modules, ongoing t, drip_interval_days 30). topical_channels where owner_space_id = Wildheart: 1 row (slug wildheart, category movement) linked to a program_only circle_templates row, and the circle's topical_channel_id equals it. Not yet applied as of the checked date; the SQL was parsed with libpg-query (PostgreSQL 16 grammar) and the .mts twin runs in --sql mode.
